objectives: Apply knowledge of language elements, structures and textual conventions to explore how meaning is conveyed in texts.
Make decisions about language elements, structures and textual conventions to create or determine meaning in texts.
Interpret how meaning, attitudes, perspectives and values underpin texts and influence audiences through an investigative and/or critical process.
Analyse and evaluate information and ideas to draw conclusions, justify points of view and construct arguments in German through an investigative and/or critical process.
Create texts that communicate information and ideas in German for context, purpose, audience, tone and cultural conventions.
Structure, sequence and synthesise information to respond to texts personally, critically and/or creatively.

units.title: Guided investigation
units.description: Students enter the first phase of their development of textual investigative skills in both German and English. Subject matter is organised under areas of study selected for the unit.

units.title: Independent investigation
units.description: Students determine a topic for investigation in negotiation with their teacher, identify suitable texts, and apply the investigative skills developed in Unit 3 to an independent project.

subject_matter.areas_of_study_note: The retrieved syllabus text names 'Area of study: Literature' and 'Area of study: Social sciences' directly. Additional areas (arts; business and commerce; innovation, science and technology) are referenced in the retrieved Unit 3 and Unit 4 content but are not exhaustively catalogued in this extraction; the full area-of-study set must be confirmed against the current syllabus PDF.

internal_assessment.title: Combination response
internal_assessment.description: Internal assessment 1: Examination — combination response (20%) — Unit 3; short response plus spoken discussion.

internal_assessment.title: Investigative folio and interview
internal_assessment.description: Internal assessment 3: Investigative folio and interview (30%) — multimodal presentation in German followed by an interview.

external_assessment.title: Extended response
external_assessment.description: External assessment: Examination — extended response (25%), developed and marked by the QCAA.
